plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Helper Desk: a purple task progress bar above the prompt that moves as each to-do item is done, and a side pane that shows only the subagents still running

plugins.name: agent-alert
plugins.description: A line above your Claude Code prompt when another Claude Code session on this computer needs you (an approval, an answer), with a Go button that opens a desktop-app session's chat in the Claude desktop app, and a toast when one finishes its turn. Reads only the status files Claude Code keeps for its sessions; sends nothing.

plugins.name: setup-pane
plugins.description: A side pane, My setup, with tabs for your Claude Code setup: what it cost this week, what is scheduled, your agents, mods, plugins, skills, MCP servers, hooks and settings
